interface.signature: def isWordExist(board: List[List[str]], word: str) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in board) and all(len(row) == len(board[0]) for row in board) and len(board) > 0 and len(board[0]) > 0
preconditions.description: The board is a non-empty rectangular 2D list of strings (letters), with all rows having the same length.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(word, str) and len(word) > 0 and len(word) <= len(board) * len(board[0])
preconditions.description: The word is a non-empty string with length not exceeding the total number of cells in the board.

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(all(board[r + dr][c + dc] == word[i] for i, (dr, dc) in enumerate(path)) for r in range(len(board)) for c in range(len(board[0])) for path in _generate_paths(r, c, word))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if there exists a path in the board starting from some cell (r, c) such that the letters along the path (moving only to adjacent horizontal or vertical cells without reusing any cell) exactly spell the word, and false otherwise. The helper `_generate_paths` is defined as a function that recursively generates all possible valid paths of length `len(word)` starting from (r, c) without revisiting cells.
